Zero-Trust Enterprise Security

Your Corporate Intelligence
Remains Strictly Sovereign.

We enforce strict cryptographic isolation. No advertising telemetry, zero model training on customer transcripts, and full enterprise self-hosting readiness.

Client-Side Encryption & WebRTC DTLS/SRTP
Direct messages and media streams are encrypted point-to-point. Peer-to-peer audio and video bypass centralized recording servers.
2048-Bit RSA DKIM & Automated DNS Wizard
Every email dispatched from your custom domain carries cryptographic verification, guaranteeing zero spoofing and 100% Primary Inbox arrival.
Automated Brute-Force Shield & IP Lockout
Multi-layer rate limiting automatically triggers 24-hour IP isolation upon malicious authentication attempts and sandboxes executable attachments.
Immutable Enterprise Audit Trails & RBAC
Comprehensive activity telemetry and role-based permissions allow compliance officers to monitor workspace operations with complete confidence.
